questions.q_en:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

The volunteers worked tirelessly since six days to build homes for the underprivileged community.
questions.solution_en:
The part that contains the error is 'since'. The phrase "since six days" is incorrect because "since" is used to specify a starting point in time or an event that continues up to the present. It does not convey the duration of time worked by the volunteers. The preposition "for" is used to indicate a duration of time. Therefore, the correct phrase should be "for six days," which correctly communicates the duration of time during which the volunteers worked tirelessly to build homes for the underprivileged community. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: The volunteers worked tirelessly for six days to build homes for the underprivileged community.

Examples

II. We're going to a party.

In the streets, prosperous/ citizens has / pushed their way / towards the palace gates.
questions.solution_en:
The helping verb 'has' in the given sentence should be used according to the subject 'citizens'. Since the subject is plural in nature, we cannot use the singular helping verb 'has'. The plural helping verb 'have' is appropriate in the given sentence. Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Select the grammatically correct sentence.
options_en: The warrior was waiting for an right time to attack the lion hiding in a cave.
The warrior was waiting for the right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave.
An warrior was waiting for a right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave.
The warrior was waiting for a right time to attack an lion hiding in the cave.
questions.solution_en:
The grammatically correct sentence is 'The warrior was waiting for the right time to attack the lion hiding in the cave'. This sentence uses the appropriate definite article 'the' before the words 'warrior' and 'lion', indicating specific individuals or entities. Additionally, it correctly uses the phrase 'the right time'. The phrase 'the right time' is the correct choice because it refers to a particular moment that the warrior is waiting for. Using 'an right time' is grammatically incorrect as 'an' is used before words that begin with a vowel sound. Options (a), (c), and (d) contain grammatical errors. In option (a), 'an right time' should be 'the right time'. Similarly, options (c) and (d) have similar errors with the use of "an" instead of "the" before the words "warrior" and "lion."

Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

NOTE:

An article is a word that comes before a noun to indicate whether it's specific or general.

Definite and indefinite articles: In the English language, we have one definite article 'the'; it refers to or introduces, a particular, specific noun. 'An' and 'a' are indefinite articles; they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun.

questions.q_en:
Select the most appropriate order of the segments in the options that will fill in the blanks and make a coherent paragraph.

The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, combined ______________/ ________________/ __________________ /_______________ innovation, consumer protection, and ethical practices.
options_en: to reevaluate their regulatory frameworks/ aiming to strike a balance between / with growing concerns about data privacy and security/ has prompted governments and industries worldwide
with growing concerns about data privacy and security/ has prompted governments and industries worldwide/ to reevaluate their regulatory frameworks/ aiming to strike a balance between
has prompted governments and industries worldwide/ with growing concerns about data privacy and security/ aiming to strike a balance between/ to reevaluate their regulatory frameworks
aiming to strike a balance between/ to reevaluate their regulatory frameworks/ with growing concerns about data privacy and security/ has prompted governments and industries worldwide
questions.solution_en:
"With growing concerns about data privacy and security" introduces the context, indicating that concerns about data privacy are a driving factor. It appropriately follows the verb "combined", forming the meaningful phrase "combined with" implying that growing concerns about data privacy and security are also certain factors along with the rapid advancement of AI.

"Has prompted governments and industries worldwide" follows logically, showing the reaction to these concerns.

"To reevaluate their regulatory frameworks" explains what the governments and industries are doing in response.

"Aiming to strike a balance between" concludes the paragraph by specifying their goal (balancing innovation, protection, and ethics).

So, the complete coherent paragraph is: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, combined with growing concerns about data privacy and security, has prompted governments and industries worldwide to reevaluate their regulatory frameworks, aiming to strike a balance between innovation, consumer protection, and ethical practices.

Hence, option (b) is the answer.

questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The skill has been perfected by my mentor. I have been shaped by my mentor since my adulthood.
options_en: My mentor has perfected the skill. Since my adulthood, my mentor has shaped me.
My mentor has been perfected the skill. Since my adulthood, my mentor has shaped me.
My mentor has perfected the skill. Since my adulthood, my mentor have shaped me.
My mentor is perfected the skill. Since my adulthood, my mentor having shaped me.
questions.solution_en:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ('been' in this case) and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Present Perfect tense. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Present Perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.

For example:

A new horse has been bought by Arya. (Passive Voice)

Arya has bought a new horse. (Active Voice)

The options except (a) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

Note:

V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

Directions [Set of 4 Questions]:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

One day, a very long time ago, some of the Naayire people went hunting. They walked and walked in the bush but found nothing. When night came, they were very far from home. "We must sleep in the bush," the chief said, "we must find a good place to sleep. "The hunters were not afraid to sleep in the bush. But they knew elephants, lions and other animals sometimes killed sleeping hunters. And there were some bad people, too, in the bush.

The hunters came to a place with big trees around it. They decided to rest and sleep on the grass. They did not make a fire and ate only some nuts which they carried in their bags. That was their supper. Then they went to sleep. All of them were tired. They slept soundly and did not hear anything. They did not hear that their enemies were coming nearer and nearer to them. But in one of the trees above the sleeping men, something moved and fell on the head of a young hunter. He jumped up and cried a big python was on his head!

The Naayire hunters got up quickly and saw the enemies around them. A fight began. Soon the enemies ran away and that was the end of the fight. The Naayire hunters came up to their chief to talk about the fight. "What made you jump up?" the chief asked the young hunter. "It was a python," he said. "It fell on my head, but it did not kill me." Then the chief said, "From this day on our people will never kill a python. That python saved our lives. Pythons will be sacred animals in our country." Even today the Naayire people love pythons. If you go into their houses in the rainy season, you will find a python there. The pythons never harm anyone. They don't eat even the chickens.

In the question given below, a sentence is given, divided into parts. One of the parts may contain an error. Identify the part that contains the error, and mark it as the answer.

All these years, (A)/she desired nothing (B)/ but to have loved (C)/by her siblings (D).
questions.solution_en:
Part C has the error. The given sentence is in Passive voice and the format for Present Perfect tense in a passive voice is 'has/have +been+ verb'. In this part, the 'to-be' form of the verb 'been' is missed out.

Alternatively, 'have loved' can be replaced with 'be loved'.

The correct sentence is: All these years, she desired nothing but to have been loved by her siblings.

OR

All these years, she desired nothing but to be loved by her siblings.

questions.q_en:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the question that follows.

As a result of increasing population and expansion of residential areas, forest lands are being encroached. This is not all; even the wildlife is under extreme threat. As our fauna is facing a dearth of adequate shelter in forests, they are heading towards towns and hence get killed by hunters. Consequently, many animal species have either become extinct or are on the verge of extinction. The Black Buck is almost endangered and found only in two countries, Nepal and India. In India, this antelope is found in many national parks like Guindy National Park, Point Calimere and Vellandu sanctuaries of Tamil Nadu, Rollapadu of Andra Pradesh, few parts of Rajasthan and Haryana. As far as their habitat is concerned, they live in open grasslands, dry areas or thinly populated areas and near water resources. They live in the desert areas of Rajasthan and coastal areas because they cannot sustain cold climate. They are the fastest running animals on this planet. Further, this animal is active during the day but slows down in its activities after midday. They are social beings. Hence, they move with their herds, which can vary from 3 to 23 mates. They cohabit twice in a year and give birth twice in a year. Prior to independence, this antelope was extensively hunted which affected their population so much that this species has reached the stage of extinction in many parts of the country. Poachers kill them mainly for material gain. Its skin has an enormous value in the market. In order to protect this species, the IUCN has declared this species nearly threatened. Hence, under Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act of 1972, numerous stern measures have been taken. To specify a few, Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary (Bihar), Gir Forest National Park, Velavadar Wildlife Sanctuary (Gujarat), National Chambal Sanctuary, etc. Despite these acts, hunting is adversely affecting our wildlife. There are some solutions to this problem but the best one is to boycott the products made from endangered species at an international level. This seems to be effective but will it prevent animal hunting? That's a question.

The Black Buck is killed because of hunters' _______.
questions.solution_en:
The passage explicitly states, "Poachers kill them mainly for material gain. Its skin has an enormous value in the market." This indicates that the primary motivation for hunting Black Bucks is financial profit from selling their valuable skin, aligning with "material gain."

(a) personal gratification: The passage does not mention hunters killing Black Bucks for personal satisfaction or emotional fulfilment, only for material gain.

(c) need: There is no indication that hunters kill Black Bucks out of necessity (e.g., for survival or food). The focus is on commercial gain.

(d) fun: The passage does not suggest hunting is done for enjoyment or sport, only for profit-driven motives.

Hence, the correct answer is option (2).

questions.q_en: Describe how you will say All of us asked them to submit their jewels in passive voice.
options_en: Our jewels were being asked to be submitted by all of us.
Our jewels are asked to be submitted by all of us.
They were asked to submit their jewels by all of us.
Our jewels will be asked to be submitted by all of us.
questions.solution_en:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of the verb 'were' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).
